# moodgym

> Interactive, evidence-based CBT and Interpersonal Therapy self-help program for managing depression and anxiety.

moodgym is a digital mental health platform developed by e-hub Health that provides interactive skills training grounded in cognitive behaviour therapy. The program combines psychological techniques with online modules to help users develop coping strategies for depression and anxiety management.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT)
- Depression and Anxiety Management
- Self-Help Program
- Evidence-Based Intervention
- Interactive Modules
- Psychological Skills Training
- Mental Health Training
- Online Mental Health
- Crisis Resources
- Interpersonal Therapy
- Randomised Controlled Trials (RCTs)
- e-hub Health
- Lifeline
- Digital Mental Health
